cases.title: Case planning and approval gate
cases.user_goal: Review the complete case contract and prove that execution and simplified verification cannot bypass exact-snapshot human approval.
preconditions: The active change contains current requirements and acceptance contracts.
No approval exists for the newly generated snapshot.
steps: Generate and inspect the normalized case snapshot.
Attempt execution without a matching human approval.
Request light, compact, or simplified verification.
expected_results: The complete case contract is visible and schema-valid.
Absent, stale, service-authored, or hash-mismatched approval blocks execution.
The full six-domain V2 contract remains mandatory.

cases.title: Managed runtime and runner-oracle boundaries
cases.user_goal: Prove locked runtime diagnosis, immutable attempt identity, explicit adapters, and deterministic final-oracle boundaries without fallback.
preconditions: The business repository dependency manifests remain unchanged.
steps: Run runtime doctor and inspect package and browser identities.
Execute command and Playwright adapter identity tests.
Submit Midscene-only observations without a deterministic oracle.
expected_results: Exact versions, browser readiness, provider state, permissions, and blockers are reported.
Changed retry fingerprints are rejected.
Model-only evidence cannot produce PASS.

cases.title: Evidence integrity, readings, six-domain aggregation, and freshness
cases.user_goal: Prove that only intact evidence can produce readings and that six-domain, freshness, rerun, and release decisions are fact-derived.
preconditions: The approved case snapshot is available.
EvidenceStore starts from an empty append-only raw log.
steps: Persist and validate identity-bound evidence.
Derive readings and aggregate all six domains.
Change source fingerprints and compute freshness and rerun scope.
expected_results: Tampered, missing, stale, empty, or forged evidence blocks green.
Every approved case receives six terminal domain results.
Rerun scope returns affected case IDs and reasons.

cases.title: Failure, repair, retry, retest, regression, and break-loop
cases.user_goal: Preserve failures while governing classification, repair, retry, retest, regression, closure, reopen, and no-progress escalation.
preconditions: A deterministic case has a captured initial failure.
The failure packet is frozen before repair.
steps: Classify the failure and route repair to Development.
Exercise identical retry and changed-code retest.
Run regression scope and a repeated no-progress cycle.
expected_results: Failure evidence remains immutable.
Retry success is FLAKY and repaired success is PASS AFTER FIX.
Regression controls closure and no-progress routes to break-loop.

cases.title: Three-page report center
cases.user_goal: Review overview, case catalog, and case results pages across all states with accessible, responsive, print-safe, and secure evidence presentation.
preconditions: Validated report models exist for every supported state.
steps: Render all three pages from one report model.
Exercise desktop, mobile, keyboard, and print layouts.
Inject hostile markup and provider-secret fixtures and alter rendered HTML.
expected_results: Required lifecycle, case, attempt, evidence, repair, and release facts are visible.
Layouts remain readable and operable without overlap.
Content is escaped and redacted, and HTML cannot change gate truth.

cases.title: V1-to-V2 migration
cases.user_goal: Migrate legacy verification artifacts with dry-run, backup, receipt, validation, rollback, and fail-closed missing-evidence semantics.
preconditions: Disposable V1 fixtures include valid, incomplete, and malformed artifacts.
No production change is mutated by fixture execution.
steps: Run migration dry-run.
Migrate fixtures and validate the receipt.
Migrate V1 green with missing evidence.
expected_results: Backup, validation, and rollback are visible before mutation.
Receipt hashes bind inputs and outputs.
Missing evidence becomes BLOCKED, never PASS.

cases.title: Shared Kernel and three-host integration
cases.user_goal: Prove one host-neutral kernel and thin synchronized adapters across Codex, Claude Code, and CodeFree-O.
preconditions: The canonical kernel and immutable host lock are present.
Claude Code and CodeFree-O sibling repositories are available for compatibility validation.
steps: Run shared fixtures through all host adapters.
Inspect adapter and service boundaries.
Mutate a disposable host identity and run drift detection.
expected_results: All hosts produce the same normalized results.
Verdict semantics remain inside the kernel.
Any host or generated-contract drift blocks compatibility.

cases.title: Release and archive gate
cases.user_goal: Release and archive only when complete fresh V2 evidence, reports, migration, and all host proofs are green.
preconditions: All approved cases have fresh six-domain readings and reports.
Three clean-host receipts and migration status are available.
steps: Build release and archive gate inputs.
Remove or tamper with each required input in fixtures.
Run transactional archive success and rollback fixtures.
expected_results: Gate identity binds all source facts.
Every missing, stale, tampered, open, incompatible, or simplified state blocks.
Archive preserves evidence and rolls back safely on failure.
